title: Kim Jong Un visits naval college and South Hamgyong development sites amid US summit speculation
detail: Per KCNA via Herald, Kim visited the Kim Jong-suk Naval College on Nov 18-19, 2026 with Pak Jong-chon, and inspected local development construction in Riwon and Rakwon counties. Coverage links the activity to speculation about a possible North Korea-US summit; Pyongyang says Kim is not in communication with Trump.

media.caption: Kim inspects development sites in Riwon, Rakwon counties
